title: A comfortable chord shape
description: Several shapes compared, with the strings and the finger placement made clear.

blocks.text: A large reference doesn’t help if the position it offers is hard to play or to read.

quote.text: Most of the harder chord shapes the app suggests like C9, D9 etc are not really playable. It feels like this was all generated by a computer instead of a guitar player who gives chord shapes that are actually possible to play.

blocks.text: Show the shapes that apply side by side, mark the barre and the muted strings. Let the change to the next chord of your own song be compared.
The diagrams have to be checked on the instrument. The number of variants is no substitute for whether they can be played.
